title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 54-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up regarding his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling generally well today and denies any new symptoms of fatigue, swelling, or changes in urinary output. He has been compliant with his prescribed medications and has been monitoring his blood pressure at home. He notes that his laboratory results from last month were stable. He expresses no concerns regarding his current treatment plan.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented x3. Vital signs are stable. Physical examination reveals no peripheral edema and clear lung sounds. Heart sounds are regular without murmurs. Skin is intact without signs of uremic frost.

Assessment
Chronic kidney disease, stage 3a. The patient is currently stable on his current medication regimen.

Plan
Continue current medications. Order follow-up laboratory work including serum creatinine and electrolyte panel in three months. Patient instructed to monitor blood pressure and report any significant changes. Follow-up in 90 days.

distractors.why: Stage 3a is documented; do not use unspecified stage 3.
